title: 第7章 早朝交锋，以工代赈
slug: 快活小御医恭喜皇后有喜了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林墨直起身，不再理会已经吓傻的赵德全。

目光扫过，院子里其他噤若寒蝉的太医和太监，朗声道：

“都听着，从今天起，太医院但凡有谁敢阳奉阴违，拉帮结派，别怪我林墨不讲情面！”

说完，他理了理自己的官袍，对着冷月拱了拱手。

“冷将军，今夜有劳了。”

“改日，林某必有重谢。”

冷月看着眼前这个判若两人的年轻太医，眼神里闪过一丝复杂神色，回应道：

“林院丞客气了，本官只是奉命行事。”

林墨不再多言，昂首挺胸，在一众敬畏、恐惧、怨毒的目光中，大步流星地离开了现场。

第二天一早，林墨换上了崭新的正六品院丞官服，整个人看起来精神焕发。

他按照规矩，先去了一趟凤仪宫。

这一次，宫门口的太监和宫女们，看他的眼神不再是之前的不屑与冷淡。

而是充满了敬畏和巴结讨好。

“林院丞，您来了！”

“娘娘已经在里面等您了。”

慕容雪早已屏退了左右，只留下心儿这个心腹宫女在旁伺候。

她今天穿了一件淡黄色的宫装，脸上略施粉黛，看起来气色比昨天好了许多。

见到林墨，她那双美丽的凤眸里，明显多了一丝依赖和感激。

“林墨，你来了，快坐。”

“臣参见皇后娘娘。”林墨规规矩矩地行了个礼。

“这里没有外人，不必多礼。”慕容雪示意他坐下。

“昨晚太医院的事，我听说了。”

“你……没受委屈吧？”

林墨心里一暖，摇了摇头：“娘娘放心，一点小事，都解决了。”

他知道，自己和这位皇后，现在是真正绑在一条船上的蚂蚱了。

“那就好！”慕容雪松了口气，随即脸色又变得凝重起来。

“林墨，既然我们如今……”

“有些事，我也该让你知道了。”

她开始详细为林墨分析，当今朝堂的势力格局。

武太后一党，是朝中最大的势力。

太后的亲弟弟，武承嗣，手握京城三大营之一的“神策军”，堪称京城禁军之外最强战力。

朝中过半的文臣，都唯太后马首是瞻。

而太后最想扶持上位的，就是她的亲外甥，当今皇帝的堂弟，九王爷刘琦。

而皇帝刘烈这边，可以说是势单力薄。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Lin Mo straightened up and ignored the frightened Zhao Dequan.

He glanced over at the other silent imperial doctors and eunuchs in the courtyard, and said loudly:

"Listen, from today on, if anyone in Taiyuan Hospital dares to act against the will and form cliques, don't blame me, Lin Mo, for being ruthless!"

After saying that, he straightened his official robe and cupped his hands towards Leng Yue.

"General Leng, you have a hard time tonight."

"Someday, Lin will be grateful."

Leng Yue looked at the completely different young imperial physician in front of her, with a complicated look in her eyes, and responded:

"Lin Yuancheng is too polite. I am just following orders."

Lin Mo said no more, held his head high, and strode away from the scene in the eyes of everyone with awe, fear, and resentment.

Early the next morning, Lin Mo put on a brand-new official uniform of the sixth-grade official of the courtyard, and he looked full of energy.

Following the rules, he first went to Fengyi Palace.

This time, the eunuchs and maids at the palace gate no longer looked at him with the disdain and indifference they had before.

Instead, he was full of awe and fawning.

"Lin Yuancheng, you are here!"

"The queen is already waiting for you inside."

Murong Xue had already retreated, leaving only Xin'er, a confidant and palace maid, waiting by her side.

She wore a light yellow palace dress today, with a little makeup on her face. She looked much better than yesterday.

When she saw Lin Mo, there was obviously a hint of dependence and gratitude in her beautiful phoenix eyes.

"Lin Mo, you're here, sit down quickly."

"I see you, the Queen." Lin Mo bowed politely.

"There are no outsiders here, no need to be polite." Murong Xue motioned for him to sit down.

"I heard about what happened at the hospital last night."

"You...are not wronged?"

Lin Mo felt warm in his heart and shook his head: "Don't worry, Madam, every little thing will be solved."

He knew that he and the queen were now truly grasshoppers tied to the same boat.

"That's good!" Murong Xue breathed a sigh of relief, and then his face became solemn again.

"Lin Mo, since we are now..."

"There are some things I should let you know."

She began to analyze in detail the current power structure in the court for Lin Mo.

Empress Dowager Wu's party is the largest force in the DPRK.

The Empress Dowager's younger brother, Wu Chengsi, holds the "Shence Army", one of the three major battalions in the capital, which is the strongest combat force outside the capital's forbidden army.

More than half of the civil servants in the court followed the Queen Mother's lead.

The person the Queen Mother wanted to support most was her nephew, the cousin of the current emperor, the Ninth Prince Liu Qi.

As for Emperor Liu Lie, it can be said that he is weak and weak.
